stage0039_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Kind of.
　I don't feel too bad right now.」

stage0039_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Strange, isn't it.
　He's back in that role again.」

stage0039_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$不動$$
「Karma...
　Is that what they call fate?」

stage0039_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$カヲル$$
「You don't intend to obey something like that, do you?」

stage0039_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Then you understand why I came, don't you?」

stage0039_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カヲル$$
「A dull sense of duty doesn't suit you, does it?
　You broke that very taboo 24,000 years ago.」

stage0039_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カヲル$$
「So you should just be honest with yourself.
　After all... we're no different from them.」

stage0039_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't want to see that look on his face again.
　Even if I'm not the one standing beside him.」

stage0039_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$不動$$
「Within the cycle of rebirth, fate's partner changes...
　After 12,000 years, a new door opens.」

stage0039_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Even if where it leads is the edge of myth.」

stage0039_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Altair lost its women, and with only
　ruin ahead of us, we began surveying Vega
　to hold onto a thread of hope.）

stage0039_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$イズモ$$
（And so we planned to capture a woman able
　to endure Altair's environment, a $$レア・イグラー$$,
　and make her the Eve of our world's future.）

stage0039_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$イズモ$$
（And one of the candidates chosen was you, $$アリシア$$...）

stage0039_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$イズモ$$
（But the dimensional transfer left you in a state
　of suspended death, and you never woke.）

stage0039_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$イズモ$$
（You even left your child behind on Vega
　just to come here to Altair...）

stage0039_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$イズモ$$
（...But I am not permitted to stop...）

stage0039_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$イズモ$$
（I'm counting on you, $$ジン$$...
　The $$レア・イグラー$$ riding the Mechanical Angel...
　bring her back, no matter what.）

stage0039_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$イズモ$$
（That is the true Eve who will save Altair's tomorrow.）

stage0039_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Heh heh... $$イズモ$$'s with $$アリシア$$ again, is he...
　A wingless butterfly's scales are but an illusion...）

stage0039_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（The butterfly hints at rebirth...
　A forbidden love, too, will be reborn...）

stage0039_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$...!
　Why do you keep me bound like this?!」

stage0039_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... doesn't this remind you of your childhood?
　The helpless boy you were, when we were together...」

stage0039_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I'm not...! I'm not that kid anymore!!
　GRAAAAAAAAAAH!!」

stage0039_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes, that's it, $$カグラ$$...
　More, much more... let loose the senseless past
　that keeps raging on inside you...!」

stage0039_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Hold nothing back, not a single drop!
　Yes... the $$アポロン$$ and $$シルフィ$$ memories in you!」

stage0039_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$シルフィ$$ is right there, close to your heart.
　Her breath is sweet, and her honeyed voice
　brings heavenly bliss.」

stage0039_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There now... you thirst for love, don't you?
　You want that forbidden union too, don't you?
　$$カグラ$$...! Want it more, and more...! More!」

stage0039_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's it...!
　Roar for love, you starving beast!!」

stage0039_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, to quench your thirst,
　set out for a love that's yours alone...」

stage0039_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Kill me...!
　I want to hold you in these hands and break you...!
　My... $$シルフィ$$eeee!!」

stage0039_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The dark embodiment of the cosmos, a hollow wanderer
　seeking new life... Yes... Vega is the edge of myth...」

stage0039_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sooner or later, they will appear...!
　And that will be when my wish comes full!」

stage0039_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ジン$$
「...I know, I know.
　My report was just a little late, that's all...」

stage0039_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'll bring back the Mechanical Angel's $$レア・イグラー$$,
　I promise. Now then...」

stage0039_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ジン$$
「Phew...
　$$イズモ$$ seems awfully anxious too, huh...」

stage0039_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ジン$$
（Guess I'm about at my limit for stalling this...）

stage0039_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There's no need to be so startled.
　You should know by now that crossing the
　wall of dimensions is nothing to me.」

stage0039_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ジン$$
「...What do you want, $$ミカゲ$$?
　Skipping the comm unit means
　this is something secret from $$イズモ$$, isn't it?」

stage0039_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're a clever one, aren't you.
　That's exactly right.」

stage0039_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'm about to send information straight
　into your mind. That's my request.」

stage0039_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ジン$$
「Wait a second.
　I haven't even agreed to this yet...」

stage0039_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're not allowed to refuse.
　This is the key to Altair's future.」

stage0039_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Are you all right...? You look a bit pale...?
　And... it seemed like someone was here just now...」

stage0039_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ジン$$
「Come to think of it, where's $$シンジ$$ today...?」

stage0039_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$シンジ$$ said he went to visit a grave with his father.」

stage0039_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Why did you bring me here...?」

stage0039_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Because this is the only place left where I can
　remember the world your mother was part of.」

stage0039_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...This red sea... does it connect to our old world...?」

stage0039_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「People can go on living by forgetting their memories.
　But there are things one must never forget.」

stage0039_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Yui taught me something irreplaceable.
　I come here to make sure I remember it.」

stage0039_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't you have a photo, or something?」

stage0039_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「None remain.
　...It's all in my heart now.
　That's enough, for now.」

stage0039_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's time.
　I'm heading back to NERV.」

stage0039_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I was happy today.
　Getting to talk with you, father.」

stage0039_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...You were worried about all sorts of things,
　but once you actually saw him, it was fine, right?」

stage0039_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't mope about it, I'm glad you came.
　It's basically like visiting your mother's grave.」

stage0039_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ミサト$$ just dragged me along, that's all.」

stage0039_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's because somewhere inside you,
　$$シンジ$$, you wanted to go.
　Be a little more honest with yourself.」

stage0039_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミサト$$
「By the way, a friend of yours came too.
　Wanted to see the red sea, our world's famous sight.」

stage0039_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm sorry...
　For intruding on your time with your father...」

stage0039_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's all right.
　My father... already left, so.」

stage0039_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Well then, I'll be around here somewhere,
　so call out when you're ready to head back.」

stage0039_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Okay...
　I plan to head back by sundown.」

stage0039_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Oh, and $$シンジ$$...
　I'm sure your father recognizes
　how hard you've been trying.」

stage0039_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ジン$$
「So $$シンジ$$'s dad is NERV's supreme commander,
　the one who built that EVA, huh?」

stage0039_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ジン$$
「Do you know about the 'Book of Genesis'?」

stage0039_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ジン$$
（Hacking into NERV's computers was a bust.
　Guess I'll have to get the intel from this guy...）

stage0039_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ジン$$
「I heard it's some document NERV has」

stage0039_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why do you know about NERV, $$ジン$$...?」

stage0039_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ジン$$
「Before I came to $c,
　I heard it at the Element academy」

stage0039_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ジン$$
「It sounded like an impressive name,
　so I got curious」

stage0039_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry...
　I've never heard of it」

stage0039_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ジン$$
（$$碇シンジ$$...
　Never thought this guy would turn out to be
　the EVA pilot $$ミカゲ$$'s so fond of...）

stage0039_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ジン$$
（Couldn't have imagined it when we first met）

stage0039_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Want me to ask $$ミサト$$ or $$リツコ$$?
　Maybe they'd know something...」

stage0039_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ジン$$
「Forget that, just tell me
　what this red sea is」

stage0039_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「This sea... it's the sea from the world we're from...」

stage0039_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ジン$$
（...Somewhere in my heart,
　part of me is glad the mission failed...）

stage0039_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ジン$$
（This is dangerous...
　If I stay on Vega any longer,
　I won't be myself anymore...）

stage0039_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ジン$$
（It's just a personal favor for $$ミカゲ$$ anyway.
　I can just say it failed）

stage0039_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ジン$$
（More importantly, the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$.
　Bring that back, and my mission's done）

stage0039_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ジン$$
「Oh... uh...
　Looking at this red sea just made me feel
　strange somehow...」

stage0039_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ジン$$
「A sea from another world, out of place here...
　Kind of like me, the transfer student...」

stage0039_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Don't say such a sad thing...」

stage0039_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's right, $$ジン$$.
　You're our friend, after all...」

stage0039_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ジン$$
「Sorry...
　My bad for saying something weird」

stage0039_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「It's okay...
　But don't forget, $$ジン$$...」

stage0039_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No matter where you're from or who you are,
　$$ジン$$... I think of you as someone precious to me」

stage0039_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ジン$$
「Thanks, $$ユノハ$$... and you too, $$シンジ$$」

stage0039_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry to interrupt the fun.
　We've got an emergency」

stage0039_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ミサト$$
「An Angel was confirmed off Tokyo Bay.
　At this rate, it'll make landfall in $$アクエリア市$$」

stage0039_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$不動$$
「Those bound by the crimson thread of fate...
　Is ruin where it leads us both...?」

stage0039_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$不動$$
「The one who spins that cruel fate...
　Show yourself!」

stage0039_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
???
「Oh... as expected.
　So you'd already noticed...」

stage0039_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... then, allow me to make my appearance」

stage0039_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Watch out, $$スオミ$$!
　This guy's our enemy!」

stage0039_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's been a while, $$ドナール・ダンテス$$.
　Not since you and Nanao made Aquarion go berserk」

stage0039_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ドナール$$
「I've never once forgotten you...!
　The enemy from another dimension
　who stole Nanao from me!」

stage0039_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Your love was simply too beautiful.
　It made me want to be a little mean」

stage0039_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I have no business with you today」

stage0039_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's been quite a while.
　Ten thousand and two thousand years...
　or maybe twenty thousand and four thousand...」

stage0039_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh... finally decided to show yourself?」

stage0039_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What an unsightly form to be in, though...
　Where did you leave your true form behind?」

stage0039_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$不動$$
「The form the eye sees is but a curse...
　An obsession with the past, nothing more...
　Is it not you who can't discard the old form?」

stage0039_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Very well, let's not waste time.
　Tell me where the 'Book of Genesis' and True Sun are」

stage0039_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come now, give me your answer,
　my lover of twenty thousand and four thousand years」

stage0039_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then watch as those you love
　fall into despair」

stage0039_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ゲパルト$$, $$ジン・ムソウ$$!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0039_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Who is this $$ジン・ムソウ$$!?」

stage0039_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ジン$$
「My name is $$ジン・ムソウ$$.
　I'm from the world of Altair」

stage0039_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ジン$$
「The world of what you all call Abductors」

stage0039_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ドナール$$
「You!
　You were their spy!?」

stage0039_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ジン$$
「The only way to break this deadlock
　is to use my power」

stage0039_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ドナール$$
「What are you saying, now of all times!?」

stage0039_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ジン$$
「If you can't trust me, then don't!
　But the only thing that can save this situation
　is the power to sever, the one I gained coming here!」

stage0039_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I can trust you, right, $$ジン$$?」

stage0039_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I can't trust you as the spy you were...
　But I can trust your friendship with $$シンジ$$」

stage0039_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$ゲパルト$$, $$ジン・ムソウ$$!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0039_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0039_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0039_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0039_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$...
　So you deny me too, huh」

stage0039_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's not it, $$ジン$$.
　I want you to know too... about our fight」

stage0039_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Because you're one of us too, $$ジン$$...
　a member of $c」

stage0039_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ジン$$
「Oh... uh...
　Looking at this red sea just made me feel
　strange somehow...」

stage0039_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ジン$$
「A sea from another world, out of place here...
　Kind of like me, the transfer student...」

stage0039_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Don't say such a sad thing...」

stage0039_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's right, $$ジン$$.
　You're our friend, after all...」

stage0039_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No matter where you're from or who you are,
　$$ジン$$... I think of you as someone precious to me」

stage0039_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ジン$$
「Thanks, $$ユノハ$$... and you too, $$シンジ$$」

stage0039_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$... meeting you was a miracle,
　it nearly takes my breath away... Holding your hand,
　I feel a little stronger... so...」

stage0039_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Even I will hold back today.
　My toast to the ace pilot will have to wait...」

stage0039_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The D-Trader is open for business, though,
　so feel free to stop by if you need anything...」
